text: CONTRADICTING: E4/E4 iMGs showed significantly lower lysosomal degradation activity (self-quenched substrate MFI) than E3/E3 iMGs. Bafilomycin, which blocks acidification, reduced the signal in control cells. Reduced acidification-dependent degradation does not fit the increased acidification predicted for APOE4.
description: Human iPSC-derived microglia (APOE3/3 vs APOE4/4 lines). Cells were incubated 1 h with the Abcam Lysosomal Intracellular Activity Assay self-quenched substrate (ab234622), and MFI in the FITC channel was read on a BD Accuri C6 Plus. The unit is the iPSC line. Caveat: microglia, not astrocytes. The readout is lysosomal and depends on uptake, protease content (CTSD was lower in E4/E4) and pH, so it is not a direct endosomal pH measure.

provenance.excerpt: Since cathepsins play an essential role in lysosomal degradation, we further analyzed lysosomal activity in iMGs using flow cytometry with an Abcam's proprietary self-quenched substrate and found that E4/E4 iMGs exhibited significantly lower lysosomal degradation activity compared to E3/E3 cells (Fig. 1G-H).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lower lysosomal degradation of self-quenched substrate in microglia) [CONTRADICTS]

perturbed.variable: APOE4/4 vs APOE3/3 genotype of iPSC-derived microglia

measured.variable: Lysosomal degradation activity: flow-cytometry MFI of a self-quenched substrate that fluoresces after lysosomal cleavage
